flows:
Navigate to https://www.colorhexa.com/ff0000 then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
Open the color picker from the red swatch next to the search field.
Press Tab through at least three controls unless the swatch gets focus sooner.
If it gets focus, press Enter.
Verify the color spectrum and hue slider appear.
